description: Parameter names by which a CALLER may select whose data is acted upon. The headline classifier. Two lists are published side by side and neither is 'the' answer.
sourceNotes: The strict list contains names that are tenant-selecting in essentially every API convention we could find. The ambiguous list contains names that are very often intra-tenant instead — a project_id inside one workspace, a user_id identifying a subject rather than a tenant. Reporting only the inclusive figure would overstate the finding; reporting only the strict figure would understate it. So both ship.
honestyNote: A match here is a PRECONDITION, not a vulnerability. The server may derive authorization from the token and reject any mismatch, and most probably do. This scanner cannot tell, because telling would require invoking the tool.

matching.normalize: Parameter names are split on snake_case, camelCase, kebab-case and dots, lowercased, and rejoined with underscores before comparison, so accountId, account-id and account.id all match account_id.
